modal.title: Change log level temporarily
modal.description: Choose how much information Kong Gateway writes to its logs. Changes automatically revert when the TTL expires.
modal.log_level_help: Selecting a log level captures logs at the selected level and all lower-severity levels.

expiration.label: Expiration
expiration.tooltip: The duration before the log level automatically reverts to its default value.

help.seconds: Enter a value between 10 seconds and 3600 seconds.
help.mins: Enter a value between 1 minute and 60 minutes.

modal.warning: Higher log levels can significantly increase log volume and disk usage. Use them only while troubleshooting.
modal.status_note: Updates typically reach all data plane nodes in about 5 seconds. Monitor progress here while the update is in progress.
